description: This file implements a linked list data structure with methods for adding, removing, retrieving size, and accessing elements by index. It defines a LinkedList class with internal Node class and some utility functions.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A class implementing a singly linked list with basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: An internal class representing a node in the linked list, holding data and reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list, returning true if successful.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index, throwing an exception if out of bounds.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private helper method to unlink a node from the list.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Companion object method to find the last node in the list.
